root_cause: Observed unwanted generated lens droplets despite a keep-clear instruction; internal model cause unverified. Cup/steam proximity may compete with the clear-lens state.
fix: Rejected and preserved S08 v001. Prepared v002 with steady upright cup, tiny eye-only glance, clean dry transparent lenses and face, and new seed. Repair generation and validation are pending.
prevention: Check lens state across first/middle/last and every-frame boards; do not accept an attractive but chronologically premature fog/sweat effect. Reduce cup motion for clear-lens reaction inserts.
